note: Unknown top-level request member — HCP's `GET /v2/directives` takes no parameters (HCP 9.4.15), so there is no filter.
Empty `accessToken` — a token has at least one character.
Missing `directives` — HCP answers 200 with a `directives` array, empty when there is none (HCP 9.4.15).
A cursor in the response — the directives list is not paginated (HCP 9.4.15).
A directive with an out-of-enum `effect` — HCP's effects are `deny`, `ask-first` and `permit` (HCP 6.4).

directives.text: Never pass my health context to another agent.
